sowing.title: Sow the paddy
sowing.description: Broadcast or transplant into the puddled field.

establishWater.title: Flood the field
establishWater.description: Hold 2-3 cm of water while the seedlings settle.

topDressing1.title: First urea dressing
topDressing1.description: Top-dress with urea now the seedlings have taken.

weeding1.title: First weeding
weeding1.description: Weed between the rows before the crop closes in.

pestScout1.title: Check for leaf folder
pestScout1.description: Walk the field and look for rolled, chewed leaves.

topDressing2.title: Second urea dressing
topDressing2.description: Top-dress again as the crop tillers strongly.

midSeasonWater.title: Top up the water
midSeasonWater.description: Bring the water back to 3-5 cm while it tillers.

pestScout2.title: Check for planthopper
pestScout2.description: Part the canopy and look for hoppers on the stems.

panicleDressing.title: Panicle dressing
panicleDressing.description: The last dressing, as the panicles start to form.

drainField.title: Drain the field
drainField.description: Let the water off about ten days before harvest.

harvest.title: Harvest the paddy
harvest.description: Cut when the grain is firm and the panicles have bent.

transplant.title: Plant out the seedlings
transplant.description: Set them out late in the day and water them in.

establishWater.title: Water in
establishWater.description: Keep the soil damp for the first week while roots take.

topDressing1.title: First top dressing
topDressing1.description: Feed once the plants start putting on new leaves.

weeding1.title: First weeding
weeding1.description: Clear the weeds before they take the fertiliser.

whitefly.title: Check for whitefly
whitefly.description: Turn leaves over; look for whitefly and curled tips.

topDressing2.title: Second top dressing
topDressing2.description: Feed again as the first flowers set.

fruitBorer.title: Check for fruit borer
fruitBorer.description: Look for holes in young fruit; remove what is hit.

topDressing3.title: Third top dressing
topDressing3.description: One more feed while the fruit is filling.

firstPicking.title: First picking
firstPicking.description: Pick as fruit colours, every two or three days.

finalPicking.title: Last picking
finalPicking.description: Take the last of the fruit and clear the plants.

transplant.title: Plant out the seedlings
transplant.description: Set them out late in the day and water them in.

establishWater.title: Water in
establishWater.description: Keep the soil damp for the first week while roots take.

topDressing1.title: First top dressing
topDressing1.description: Feed once the plants are growing away.

weeding1.title: First weeding
weeding1.description: Clear the weeds before they take the fertiliser.

thrips.title: Check for thrips
thrips.description: Look for curled, silvered leaves at the growing tips.

anthracnose.title: Check for anthracnose
anthracnose.description: Sunken dark spots on the pods; take out what is hit.

topDressing3.title: Third top dressing
topDressing3.description: A last feed while the pods are filling.

firstPicking.title: First picking
firstPicking.description: Pick the pods as they colour, every few days.

finalPicking.title: Last picking
finalPicking.description: Take the last of the pods and clear the plants.

planting.title: Plant the sets
planting.description: Set the bulbs at your spacing and water them in.

establishWater.title: Water in
establishWater.description: Keep the bed damp while the roots take.

topDressing1.title: First top dressing
topDressing1.description: Feed once the leaves start growing away.

weeding1.title: First weeding
weeding1.description: Onions lose to weeds. Keep the bed clean.

thrips.title: Check for thrips
thrips.description: Look into the leaf sheaths for silvering and insects.

topDressing2.title: Second top dressing
topDressing2.description: Feed again before the bulbs start to swell.

bulbingWater.title: Water for bulbing
bulbingWater.description: Keep the water steady; do not let the bed dry out.

purpleBlotch.title: Check for purple blotch
purpleBlotch.description: Purple patches on the leaves after wet weather.

harvest.title: Lift the onions
harvest.description: Lift when the tops fall over; dry them in the shade.

transplant.title: Plant out the seedlings
transplant.description: Set them out late in the day and water them in.

establishWater.title: Water in
establishWater.description: Keep the soil damp for the first week while roots take.

topDressing1.title: First top dressing
topDressing1.description: Feed once the plants are growing away.

weeding1.title: First weeding
weeding1.description: Clear the weeds before they take the fertiliser.

shootBorer.title: Check for shoot borer
shootBorer.description: Cut out and burn wilting shoots before it spreads.

topDressing2.title: Second top dressing
topDressing2.description: Feed again as the first flowers open.

fruitBorer.title: Check for fruit borer
fruitBorer.description: Look for entry holes; remove damaged fruit.

topDressing3.title: Third top dressing
topDressing3.description: One more feed while the fruit is filling.

firstPicking.title: First picking
firstPicking.description: Pick the fruit while the skin is still glossy.

finalPicking.title: Last picking
finalPicking.description: Take the last of the fruit and clear the plants.

generate.title: Build the calendar
generate.description: The work for the whole season is worked out from the day the crop goes in.
generate.invalid: Choose the day the crop was sown.
generate.empty: Tell us the day this crop was sown and the whole season is planned out for you.

confirm.title: Build this calendar again?
confirm.description: Work you have already done, skipped or changed is kept. Only tasks still waiting, exactly as they were planned, are replaced.
